# darksite

A design system for operator software, shipped as a **Svelte 5** package. Read `README.md` first,
then `docs/which-primitive.md`. Open requirements live in `TODO.md`.

## Rules for every change

- **Svelte 5 only** — runes, snippets, `$bindable`. No other framework, ever.
- **`ds-*` roles only** in components: never a ramp stop (`color-*`) or a literal color.
- **Type:** nothing below 12px (the one exception is the 11px uppercase navigation group title),
  nothing above weight 500. American spelling, sentence case, no emoji.
- **Touch:** 44px under `(pointer: coarse)`, with the coarse rule matching the size selector
  (`docs/density.md`).
- **Focus:** a visible `:focus-visible` on everything interactive. **Motion:** zeroed under
  `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Layout:** container queries in components; only the shell may use viewport breakpoints.
- **Tokens:** `tokens.json` is the source of truth. `src/lib/tokens.css` is generated by
  `npm run tokens` — never edit it by hand. `scripts/check-contrast.mjs` (part of lint) checks every
  documented color pair in every theme. A new pairing of roles gets a line there.

## Delivering a primitive

1. `src/lib/components/<Name>.svelte`, exported from `src/lib/index.ts`.
2. Tests beside it (`<Name>.test.ts`): roles, ARIA, keyboard, states. Anything jsdom cannot model —
   the top layer, modality, real focus, layout, container queries — goes in a `*.browser.test.ts`,
   which runs in Chromium (run `npx playwright install chromium` once). Every component is also
   rendered on the server by `src/lib/server-render.ssr.test.ts`; add new ones to its list.
3. A gallery page at `src/routes/<name>/+page.svelte`.
4. The card: `components/<Name>/README.md` (props, states, don'ts). A new primitive's card can be
   written first, as its spec; once the component is live, the card describes it and its gallery
   page shows it.
5. A row in `docs/which-primitive.md`.
6. A bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.

## This repository is public-bound

**Never put project-specific information in this repository.** darksite is general-purpose, and
nothing in it may identify or describe a product that uses it: not its name, its domain or
industry, its data, its users, its vendors or integrations, or which project asked for a feature.
That holds for code, tests, docs, examples, `TODO.md`, commit messages and tag messages alike.

A need found while adopting darksite in a project is written here as a **general need of operator
software**, with neutral examples. If a requirement only makes sense for one project, it belongs in
that project, not here.

Never name a product, employer, client, vendor or living private person, and never use realistic
data copied from a real system — not in code, tests, docs, commit messages or `TODO.md`. Use neutral
placeholders ("Field team", "R-00412", "A. Rivera"). Well-known historical figures (Ada Lovelace,
Grace Hopper) are fine as sample names, and so are the open-source color schemes the prebuilt brands
adapt, each credited in `NOTICE.md`.

## Modes and brands

- Five modes (`dark`, `light`, `paper`, `night`, `contrast`) live in `tokens.json`. A new color role
  needs a value that passes in every one; `scripts/check-contrast.mjs` checks them all.
- Brands are generated, never hand-written: the generator is `brand/generate.mjs`, the prebuilt
  brands are `brand/presets.mjs`, and `npm run brands` writes `src/lib/brands/` (lint fails if it is
  stale). The contrast pairs both use live in `brand/contrast.mjs`; a new documented pair goes there.
- A component reads roles, never ramps or literals, so every brand and mode reaches it. The rail and
  the bars read the chrome roles (`ds-rail-*`, `ds-bar-*`) through a remap at their root.

## Releases

`stratt release patch|minor` — never `major` unless the owner asks. Pushing the `vX.Y.Z` tag runs CI,
which packs the built package and attaches `darksite-X.Y.Z.tgz` to that tag's GitHub release.
Products install that tarball, pinned:
`npm install https://github.com/zebpalmer/darksite/releases/download/vX.Y.Z/darksite-X.Y.Z.tgz`.
The git-tag form, `npm install github:zebpalmer/darksite#vX.Y.Z`, is the fallback; it needs git and
builds `dist/` on install.
